post_clip.description: A customer (wearing plaid shirt) appears to conceal a small item (possibly a snack bar or packaged good) in their pocket or hand while interacting with the cashier; shortly after, they move away from the counter without completing a visible transaction for that item. The cashier remains focused on the register and does not appear to notice. This behavior is consistent with shoplifting via concealment.
